title: Open 16.3
creator: CrossFit Games
description: Seven-minute AMRAP of 10 power snatches at 75/55 lb and 3 bar muscle-ups. Light bar, high heart rate, and a bar muscle-up you have to be able to do. Scaled swapped in 5 jumping chest-to-bar pull-ups and 45/35 lb.
